evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep never frames the 10-15 minute time box or waits for customer agreement before starting probing. Jumps directly into 'Let's get you coded' and availability check.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Asked after discovery has begun: 'So let's start with a few questions to get you under right track this should take about five to ten minutes of your time.' Customer then states concerns (price quote, timeframe, arrival time), but rep had already been probing on availability and property type before asking this.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: No follow-up beyond customer's initial statement of concerns. Customer says 'I just wanted to get a price quote... timeframe to find out exactly what time the mover would arrive... times or receive the keys.' Rep acknowledges with 'Okay, no problem' and moves directly to logistics probing without digging deeper into any of those concerns.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: No reflection back. Rep does not summarize what was heard or confirm 'Did I get all of it?'
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Covered: property type (1-bedroom apartment), floor (first floor/mid-level), rooms (no other spaces), walk distance (25-30 feet), access concerns (narrow pathway with 3 steps), special items (washer/dryer, dresser, coffee table, dining table), fragile items (mirrors, glass cups). All seven logistics categories addressed.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Never asked. Rep asks 'Can I no need help in packing this is from point A to point B' (garbled/unclear phrasing) but does not offer packing service as a recognizable option.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Asked and confirmed: 'Typical back count based on your home size is fifteen to 25 boxes. Do you feel that you fall within that range? Yes.'
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Partial. Rep gives hourly rate ($103/hr per mover), trip fee ($2,040), and final estimate ($3,894 for 8-9 hours with 2 movers). Does not explicitly anchor to typical 2.5-3.5 hours for a 1-bedroom until after the estimate is stated, not before. Personalization is minimal — mentions two movers and long-distance truck reservation but does not tie estimate to customer's specific stated concerns (timeframe/arrival time anxiety).
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Full. Covers hourly rate, trip fee, inclusions (gas, truck, taxes, insurance, wraps, tools, disassembly/reassembly), and explicitly states 'no hidden fees of any type.' Also covers 2.5-hour minimum and 15-minute increments: 'it will always be prorated into fifteen minute increments.'
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked. Rep never asks 'Does that feel fair?' or any variant, and does not pause for customer reaction after stating the estimate.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Full. 'We have on time guarantee we value your time. So, if you cannot make it through the time window that we arrange we immediately start discounting money of your final bill.'
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Full. 'We have no worry damage coverage included on the already way that you're paying us we will provide up to $2,000 per move that is to repair replace and reimburse for your items.' Framed as included, no deductible/no fine print mentioned explicitly but implied by 'included.'
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: False. Rep delivers both promises but never asks 'Does that put those to rest?' or equivalent confirmation that concerns have been addressed.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Not asked. Rep moves directly to booking without asking 'What's still concerning you?' or similar genuine final-check question.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Not asked. No 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' variant.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: With_out. Rep asks 'Would you like me to lock that in for you?' which is the explicit ask, but customer immediately replies 'No, not yet. Just cause I need to talk to my wife and make sure this is within our budget.' Rather than re-ask or hold firm, rep accepts the out without re-engaging. Offers callback option instead, providing an easy exit.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: True. 'No recent securing your spot in case if you wanted to reschedule or to cancel then all you have to do is just simply give us a call at anytime.'
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Partial. Rep confirms date (October 16th), time window (8:30-9:00 AM), no deposit required. Does not confirm: phone number, final destination address (customer only gave zip code 75044, not full address), crew size (mentioned 2 movers but not explicitly confirmed in booking), or notes about customer's concerns for the crew. Customer declines to book on this call.

top_strength: Rep thoroughly gathered all seven logistics details (property type, floor, rooms, walk distance, access concerns, special items, fragile items) and delivered full pricing transparency with upfront trip fee disclosure and clear minimum/increment framing.
coaching_note: Lead with the quid pro quo (10-15 min time box + dependable quote promise + wait for yes) before any probing, and after customers state concerns, ask follow-up questions at least twice per concern to understand the full picture before jumping to logistics details.
